Ahm.. actually I just wanna share my feelings..which i experienced..that first eye contact there's a guy in my village he is 4 years older than me..nd.. usually i don't visit my village often..nd when I was a little I used to play with him..nd his lil brother who is 2 year older..nd after 7 years i visited my village again..nd saw him..he was a grown up..boy..nd i guess he has completely forgotten Abt me..i visited my village bcz there was a family function for 3 days..nd..
The best part is that his house nd my house is just like soooooo near..I can clearly see his roof house gate..nd whatever nd..there is a shop inside his house..which his family runs..nd..when I visited my village..i saw him..he was a tall guy..nd just sooooo handsome...nd..i wasn't interested abt him at first...but as u know in family function was going on..so at the evening time..I was at my roof..nd..my lil cousins..were there.. playing with me..(they r SMALLer than me..2years )so suddenly i noticed...that guy was staring at me..nd he was continuously looking at me..i noticed him..but i didn't dare to look at him..nd..then his mother came there..nd said something to him,.so he started looking somewhere else..then i started staring himm..i dk whyy 🤧...then i started looking at some where else nd.. again he started looking at me..
Nd then suddenly..our eyes met..we both were staring at eachother faces.. looking at eachother for 5-4 sec..nd then he started looking somewhere else..nd then 

My lil cousins asked me..what happened di??
I said..that guy..is looking at me..(idk why I told him that..😖)

My cousin just shouted at that guy...HEY WHY R U STARING AT MY SIS..!!!
nd I was so.. flustered... trying to stop him.. whatever he was saying out of his mouth..nd i just closed my ears..cuz..I was scared..that wht that guy will say in return...nd..bcz of that I wasnt able to listen wht he replied in return...nd then he just gone inside his house...nd this was it..,nd..we just saw each other again...idk why this ended like this...I came bck to my city..nd..that's it..but...
Few days ago..my father said that..that guy..is shifting to our city to complete his studies...nd..i just hope..we just meet again..
I love myself only because everything is just a time pass 😊
